        if (completed_inline11[63].is_valid()) params_phase_fence_barrier_2_deps[params_phase_fence_barrier_2_deps_count++] = completed_inline11[63];
        params_phase_fence_barrier_2.set_dependencies(params_phase_fence_barrier_2_deps, params_phase_fence_barrier_2_deps_count);
        TaskId joined_inline28 = TaskId::invalid();
        if (params_phase_fence_barrier_2_deps_count > 0) {
            TaskOutputTensors phase_fence_barrier_2_outs = rt_submit_dummy_task(params_phase_fence_barrier_2);
            joined_inline28 = phase_fence_barrier_2_outs.task_id();
        }
    }
